examples.title: The Effects of Tasimelteon in Participants With REM Behavior Disorder (RBD)
examples.why: Study will not longer be done. Terminated due to sponsor noncompliance.

summary: An official warning states that Tasimelteon can cause somnolence, which means extreme sleepiness, so people should only prepare for bed after taking it because it harms mental alertness [3]. Additionally, a small computer model rather than human testing estimated low risk scores for both the liver and the heart [M]. Finally, a study evaluating the drug's effects on people with a sleep condition called REM Behavior Disorder was stopped because the sponsor did not follow the required rules [5].
